reason: M8 is a duplicate PMOS tied to the same nodes as M13 (net85, VCLK1, VDD, VDD), so removing it mainly reduces effective pull-up strength/capacitance without changing topology.
impact_estimate: Low (slower charging of net85 / reduced drive; could slightly increase delay or imbalance).

reason: M7 is a duplicate PMOS tied to the same nodes as M12 (net71, VCLK1, VDD, VDD), so it can be removed while preserving the same functional role on net71.
impact_estimate: Low (reduced pull-up on net71; may worsen speed or symmetry if net71/net85 need matched strength).

reason: M5 provides one of the two NMOS cross-coupling paths between VOUT1 and VOUT2; the latch can still operate with the remaining cross-coupled device (M4), though with weaker regeneration and less symmetric behavior.
impact_estimate: Low-to-moderate (reduced regeneration/greater metastability risk; may increase decision time and sensitivity to mismatch).
